title.ko: wish · if only · would rather · It's time + 과거형
title.en: wish · if only · would rather · It's time + past simple

explain.ko: wish와 if only는 현실과 다른 소망을 나타냅니다. 현재 상황에 대한 소망은 wish + 과거형입니다(I wish I had more time). 과거에 대한 후회는 wish + had + 과거분사입니다(I wish I had started earlier). 다른 사람의 짜증나는 행동이나 변화에 대한 바람은 wish + would입니다(I wish he would stop complaining). would rather는 선호를 나타내며 같은 주어이면 would rather + 동사원형, 다른 주어이면 would rather + 주어 + 과거형입니다. It's (high) time + 과거형은 ‘이제 ~할 때가 됐다’는 뜻입니다.
explain.en: Wish and if only express unreal desires. For the present: wish + past simple (I wish I had more time). For past regret: wish + past perfect (I wish I had started earlier). For annoying habits or desired change: wish + would (I wish he would stop complaining). Would rather shows preference: same subject + base verb; different subject + past simple. It's (high) time + past simple means 'it is the right moment to act'.

rows: I wish I lived closer to work.
I wish I had listened to her.
I wish you would call more often.
I'd rather you told me the truth.

notes.ko: wish 뒤에서는 현재의 일도 과거형을 씁니다. 이를 ‘가정법 과거’라고 합니다.
notes.en: After wish, even present situations use the past simple: this is the 'unreal past'.

notes.ko: wish + would는 자기 자신의 행동에는 쓰지 않습니다. I wish I would … 는 어색합니다.
notes.en: Do not use wish + would for your own actions: I wish I would … sounds odd.
If only is stronger and more emotional than wish.

lines.t: Our neighbour has a dog that barks every night. I wish it would be quiet. I think I'd rather talk to the neighbour in person. It's high time we solved the problem.

trans.ko: 우리 옆집에는 개가 있는데 밤마다 짖어요. 저는 그 개가 조용했으면 좋겠어요. 이웃에게 직접 이야기하는 편이 낫겠다는 생각도 해요. 이제 문제를 해결할 때가 됐어요.

I am dissatisfied that the company has cut lunch breaks to thirty minutes. Staff can't rest enough. I think it's high time the company thought about its employees' health. I wish they would restore the one-hour lunch break.

prompt.ko: 현재와 과거에 대한 소망을 wish와 if only를 써서 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about wishes for the present and the past, using wish and if only.

must_include.label: wish + past simple
match: i wish i had more time

task.model: I wish I had more time. Then I could exercise every day. If only I had studied languages harder at university. It's high time I made a new habit.

model_trans.ko: 시간이 더 있으면 좋겠어요. 그러면 매일 운동할 수 있을 텐데요. 대학생 때 외국어를 더 열심히 공부했더라면 좋았을 텐데요. 이제 새로운 습관을 만들 때가 됐어요.
model_trans.en: I wish I had more time. Then I could exercise every day. If only I had studied languages harder at university. It's high time I made a new habit.
